footage.name: pixabay
footage.selection_rule: Query providers in priority order; query the next provider for the same search when the previous one returned fewer than 3 assets or failed; merge all assets and keep the highest relevance score (ties go to the earlier provider).

matching.strategy: analyse scene -> multi-query search -> filter -> score -> threshold -> retry -> disclosed fallback
matching.relevance_note: scores are uncalibrated relevance rankings, not probabilities; labels use documented thresholds

cost_estimate.basis: All configured providers are free to call (Edge TTS endpoint, local Whisper, free-tier footage APIs). Local compute, bandwidth and any provider rate limits are not priced.
